scientific_integrity.claim_scope: A planar active Brownian particle with independent Poisson redraws of absolute orientation, stationary angle initialization, rotational Brownian diffusion and isotropic translational noise. Exact finite-time covariance, prescribed-drift diffusion-tensor disk, sharp isotropy feasibility and uniquely extremal reset protocols.
limits: Covariance isotropy does not imply rotational symmetry of the spatial law.
Results assume angular stationarity at initial time; arbitrary initial orientation has different finite-time covariances.
No claim for particle-position resets, relative-angle tumbles, chirality, angular feedback, or interacting particles.
Numerical diagnostics are not exhaustive or independently certified; the proof is analytic.
Originality is assessed from inspected primary literature and subject to independent priority assessment.

title: Sharp drift–isotropy synthesis for orientationally reset active Brownian particles
